niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel complete, structured, and task-oriented, with clear hierarchy, visible actions, and enough content density to feel useful. They generally like balanced layouts with grouped sections, explicit labels, and strong affordances, but they are inconsistent on visual theme and some presentation details such as brightness, button color, and card style.

criteria.description: Clear, well-grouped sections with a strong top-to-bottom structure and obvious visual hierarchy.
Screens that feel populated and complete rather than empty, sparse, or unfinished.
A prominent, easy-to-find main action button or next step.
Distinct grouped sections or cards that separate content cleanly and make scanning easier.
List items that show useful identity details such as names, numbers, avatars, labels, or status.
Clear per-item controls such as unblock, delete, toggle, chevron, or other obvious row-level actions.
Layouts with balanced distribution of content, moderate whitespace, and no large dead areas.
Direct, specific, explanatory microcopy that tells the user what the feature does and what to do next.
Interfaces that feel practical, functional, and production-ready rather than promotional or lifestyle-oriented.
